# Primary-literature search ledger

Search date: 21 July 2026.

| Theme | Primary source | What is established | Boundary for P5 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lattice formulation | [Wilson 1974](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevD.10.2445) | Link variables, plaquette action, confinement framework | Incidence locality is classical |
| Lattice review | [Kogut 1983](https://doi.org/10.1103/RevModPhys.55.775) | Standard lattice gauge formalism and algorithms | General background only |
| Overrelaxation | [Adler 1981](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevD.23.2901) | Local overrelaxation for multiquadratic actions | P5 is not a new update |
| Gauge overrelaxation | [Brown--Woch 1987](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevLett.58.2394) | Accelerated pure-gauge Monte Carlo updates | Local staple use is classical |
| Analytic smearing | [Morningstar--Peardon 2004](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevD.69.054501) | Differentiable gauge-covariant stout smearing | P5 analyzes realizability cost, not smoothing performance |
| Wilson flow | [Lüscher 2010](https://arxiv.org/abs/1006.4518) | Smooth renormalized flowed gauge fields | P5 does not compete with flow |
| Flow/smearing relation | [Nagatsuka--Sakai--Sasaki 2023](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.09938) | Analytic limiting equivalence and numerical comparison | Confirms a developed smoothing literature |
| Riemannian center | [Karcher 1977](https://doi.org/10.1002/cpa.3160300502) | Riemannian center-of-mass construction | Mean geometry is classical |
| Riemannian uniqueness | [Afsari 2011](https://doi.org/10.1090/S0002-9939-2010-10541-5) | Existence, uniqueness, convexity radii | Used for context, not claimed as new |

Direct searches included “staple dispersion lattice gauge,” “staples Fréchet
mean lattice gauge,” and local-link update effects on neighboring plaquettes.
They returned smoothing and flow papers but no direct theorem matching the
minimum-spill form.  A human expert should still inspect references and citing
papers of the update and smearing literature.
